tailoring.headline: Associate SAP Commerce (Hybris) & QA Engineer | Java, Spring & OCC APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, database performance tuning, and automated testing with JUnit. Proven delivery of data and API integrations, quality assurance, code reviews, and agile collaboration.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Associate Engineer, QA Hybris
cover_en.hook: Nagarro’s reputation for delivering complex engineering solutions makes this Associate Engineer, QA Hybris role an exciting opportunity. I bring over 5 years of hands-on experience building, testing, and scaling enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed, developed, and tested core backend functionality and extensions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, ensuring robust platform quality.

bullets.label: Automated Testing & Quality
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit and performed rigorous testing across Promotions, OMS, and catalog modules to maintain high code quality.

bullets.label: API & Integration Delivery
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, executing rigorous validation and integration testing across PIM, ERP, and MDM data pipelines.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Troubleshooting
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed code reviews, and conducted deep production troubleshooting to resolve integration bottlenecks and performance issues.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Commerce expertise adds value to Nagarro.

tailoring.why_company: Nagarro stands out for its engineering excellence, global footprint, and commitment to delivering impactful digital products. I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java engineering experience to Nagarro to help ensure the highest quality, stability, and performance of enterprise e-commerce solutions for your global clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce and Java engineering experience to drive quality and robust delivery in Nagarro's projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce (Hybris) and Java engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Associate Engineer, QA Hybris role at Nagarro. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Associate Engineer, QA Hybris - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Associate Engineer, QA Hybris position at Nagarro.

With over 5 years of professional experience building, testing, and supporting enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, and automated testing.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving a notice period until 15.12.2026, with an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
